data_description_zh:
1.本調查依據老人福利法第 10條辦理。調查採實地訪查方式辦理，除訪查 65歲以上人口
外，為瞭解即將邁入高齡之人口狀況，循例亦訪問 55-64 歲人口(主卷)，本次調查位關
心家庭照顧者，另外又訪問 55 歲以上生活需要他人協助或照顧者其主要家庭照顧者(副
卷)。本次主卷(55 歲以上)共完成 6,803 份有效樣本，副卷(主要家庭照顧者)共完成 503
份有效樣本。
2.調查項目包括 55 歲以上人口家庭及居住、健康與自我照顧能力、就業及經濟、社會活
動、大眾運輸友善、住進住宿式機構意願及個人看法，以及主要家庭照護者負擔等資料，
作為政府制定老人相關福利政策之參考。
3.調查實施計畫、抽樣設計、調查表，可參閱衛生福利部統計處網頁址：
https://dep.mohw.gov.tw/DOS/lp-5095-113.html)。
notes_zh:
1.調查表分主卷(針對個案樣本)與副卷(針對主要家庭照顧者)，為避免影響主卷之回
表與調查品質，主要家庭照顧者副卷係採由主要照顧者自願填答方式辦理，致回
收樣本數有限，且分配未必與母體一致，應用時請審慎。
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分
證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等
欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審
核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。

data_description_en:
1. This survey was conducted pursuant to Article 10 of the Senior Citizens Welfare Act. The survey used in-person field interviews; in addition to surveying the population aged 65 and older, and following past practice, it also surveyed the population aged 55-64 (main form) in order to understand the status of the population approaching old age. This survey focused on family caregivers, and additionally surveyed the primary family caregivers (supplementary form) of persons aged 55 and older whose daily living requires assistance or care from others. This round completed 6,803 valid samples for the main form (55 and older) and 503 valid samples for the supplementary form (primary family caregivers).
2. Survey items include, for the population aged 55 and older: family and living conditions, health and self-care ability, employment and economic status, social activities, public-transportation friendliness, willingness to move into residential-care institutions and personal views, and the burden on primary family caregivers, among other data, to serve as a reference for the government in formulating elderly-related welfare policy.
3. The survey implementation plan, sampling design, and questionnaire can be found on the website of the Department of Statistics, Ministry of Health and Welfare: https://dep.mohw.gov.tw/DOS/lp-5095-113.html).
notes_en:
1. The survey form is divided into a main questionnaire (for the case sample) and a supplementary questionnaire (for the primary family caregiver). To avoid affecting the return of and
the quality of the main questionnaire, the primary family caregiver supplementary questionnaire was completed voluntarily by the primary caregiver, so
the number of returned samples is limited and the distribution is not necessarily consistent with the population; please use with caution.
※This Center's database has been de-identified: directly identifiable fields such as name and address have been deleted, and fields such as national
ID number, healthcare facility code, insured unit code, unified business number, date of birth, date of medical visit and date of admission
have all been masked. The data may only be used in the independent work area set up by this Ministry, and only statistical results that have passed
review may be taken out, to ensure that the use and disclosure of the data cannot identify specific individuals.
